purpose.zh: 练肩膀和手臂后侧，让往上推更有力
purpose.en: Build your shoulders and the backs of your arms for stronger overhead pressing.

text.zh: 从耳朵高度往上推，推到手臂快伸直
text.en: Press up from ear height until your arms are almost straight

text.zh: 手肘在手腕正下方，稍微在身体前面。
text.en: Keep your elbows under your wrists and a little in front of your body.

text.zh: 肋骨往下收，身体不后仰。
text.en: Keep your ribs down and do not lean back.

commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back to press.

cautions.zh: 从轻重量开始，出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with a light weight, and stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹着疼时，缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.

changes: 文案与动画一致；cue3 去掉和起止口令重复的「慢慢放回」
主口令和 purpose 改口语（「三头肌」→手臂后侧）；cautions 短句
